name: groundwork-mods
description: Setup Doctor and an agent policy pack: read-only by default, drafts allowed, sends blocked, writes logged.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Off by default. The Fleet pane (/fleet): what waits on you in every session, this session's agents, threads and background shells, a usage band, the Black Box, a log of what Claude did that is not tamper-proof (/blackbox) and Plain Mode (/plain). Plain Mode stays off until you switch it on; it then makes small model calls on your own quota (measured: about 1,100 tokens per So what, about 400 per question set), at most 50,000 tokens a day, each call logged to ~/.burnmon/overhead. Start a new session after switching.

gitLane.title: Git lane
gitLane.description: Off by default. The Git lane (/git): your change as one lane from changes to merged, the next step as one button with the exact commands shown first, a guard on Claude's risky git, a Test Bench and a PR Desk. No model calls of its own (its Ask Claude buttons send a prompt in your session). Start a new session after switching.
